title: Croatian Flatbread Pizza
description: A simple flatbread pizza recipe with a twist of Croatian flavors. This dish is perfect for a quick snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Energizing
ingredients.notes: Optional, add a burst of energy

instructions: Place the flatbread on a baking sheet.
Spread a thin layer of pizza sauce or homemade pizza topping on each flatbread piece.
Add shredded mozzarella cheese, if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Top with hazy, energizing, and dish, to taste.
Optional: Add another layer of Croatian flatbread for extra flavor.
